title: 학생군사교육실시령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Regulations) The regulations, as defined in Article 4(1) of the Act, must include the following items: <amended November 29, 2016>
1. The purpose of establishing the officer candidate program for military personnel within the region.
2. Details regarding the curriculum and operation of the officer candidate program for military personnel within the region.
3. Details regarding the organization of the military personnel training unit and the personnel management of reserve officers (hereinafter referred to as "reserve officers") as defined in Article 4(2) of the Act.
4. Any other matters necessary for the implementation of military training.
